create_MjRenderPool: create an MjRenderPool with N workers to render images from a MuJoCo model in parallel
render_images_with_depth: render RGB images and depth maps from an MjRenderPool using pool.render with depth=True
render_with_camera: render images from a named camera in the MuJoCo scene using pool.render with camera_name
render_with_states: render images from different simulation states by passing a list of states to pool.render
render_with_texture_modder: render randomized images using an MjRenderPool with TextureModder and randomize=True
